core_rules.architecture_exclusions: Respect every selected/linked ID, native parent and alias in architecture-v0.1/exclusions.json, including patched views.
core_rules.ownership: Retain native source train/development ownership; historical validation/calibration/test and complete native heldouts remain protected.
core_rules.views: One menu per training parent; do not count transformed duplicates as new examples. GSM dev uses paired four/ten-choice presentations.
core_rules.labels: Keep native answers, original teacher distributions and independently executed Python targets distinct.
core_rules.when2call: Four-action view when native responses have distinct policies; ambiguous pairs retain their native preference task and are quarantined from the fourway release.
core_rules.knowledge: Native MMLU labels retained; the larger-menu slice is scalar-only with distinct rational values, not retrieved free-text negatives. Topic tags are heuristics, not native subjects.
core_rules.code: Python literal view independently executed in restricted CPU worker; short allowlisted programs only, exact serialized source gold verification.
core_rules.weights: Source/task/class-stratified sampling; initial loss weights all one. No automatic inverse-frequency letter weighting.
